name: Masala Dosa
description: A home-cook-friendly indian breakfast with balanced, satisfying flavors. Ready in about 50 minutes.
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender, then roughly mash them. Cook the onion and mustard seeds in a little oil, add the potatoes and seasonings, and keep the filling warm.
Heat a flat griddle and spread a ladle of dosa batter into a thin circle. Drizzle lightly with oil and cook until the bottom is crisp.
Spoon the potato filling down the centre, fold the dosa over it, and serve hot with chutney or sambar.

name: Vegetable Poha
description: A home-cook-friendly indian breakfast with balanced, satisfying flavors. Ready in about 30 minutes.
instructions: Prepare and measure the ingredients; rinse grains or legumes and chop the vegetables.
Warm oil in a heavy pan over medium heat. Cook the aromatics and spices first, add the main ingredients with a splash of water, and cook until tender and fragrant.
Taste and adjust the seasoning. Finish with fresh herbs or lemon, then serve warm.

name: Chana Masala
description: A home-cook-friendly indian dinner with balanced, satisfying flavors. Ready in about 50 minutes.
instructions: Rinse, drain, and prepare the ingredients. Measure the spices and keep the garnish separate.
Soften the aromatics in oil, stir in the spices and main ingredients, then add stock or water. Simmer gently until everything is cooked through and the sauce is flavorful.
Taste, adjust salt and acidity, and finish with the listed herbs or garnish before serving.
